meta.name: notion-knowledge-capture
meta.description: Transforms conversations and discussions into structured documentation pages in Notion. Captures insights, decisions, and knowledge from chat context, formats appropriately, and saves to wikis or databases with proper organization and linking for easy discovery.

copy.tagline: 把聊天讨论自动整理成 Notion 结构化文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在聊天中产生决策和洞察，需要系统化保存到 Notion。
copy.tagline_en: Turn chat discussions into structured Notion docs automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often make decisions in chats and need to save them to Notion systematically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会将对话中的关键信息、决策、见解等提取出来，整理成结构化的文档，并保存到你的 Notion 工作区中，同时添加链接和标签以便查找。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 将信息保存到 Notion，或者对话中产生了需要记录的知识点时，技能会触发。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的部署步骤保存到 Notion 的 wiki 里。
say.note: Claude 会提取步骤并创建页面。

say.text: 将这次会议的决定记录到决策日志数据库。
say.note: Claude 会结构化内容并保存。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts key information, decisions, and insights from conversations, structures them into documentation, and saves to your Notion workspace with proper links and tags for discoverability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to save information to Notion, or when knowledge worth capturing emerges in conversation.

say_en.text: Save the deployment steps we discussed to the Notion wiki.
say_en.note: Claude will extract steps and create a page.

say_en.text: Record this meeting's decisions in the decision log database.
say_en.note: Claude will structure and save the content.
